title: Qualified prescribed-qbot 12-case matrix
question: At the prospectively selected wet-convergent timestep, does the selected adaptive hydraulic representation preserve the analytical prescribed-qbot Richards response across all four materials and wet-mid-dry regimes?
decision_rule: Prescribed-qbot coverage advances only on 12/12 PASS. The previously observed F-AHL21 0.25-day failures remain valid outside this bounded timestep envelope.
